title: Filtered colimits of sets and of abelian groups commute with finite limits
statement: Let $\mathcal I$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], $\mathcal J$ a finite category (finitely many objects and morphisms) and $M:\mathcal I\times\mathcal J\to\textit{Sets}$, $(i,j)\mapsto M_{i,j}$, a functor. Then the canonical map $\varinjlim_i\varprojlim_jM_{i,j}\to\varprojlim_j\varinjlim_iM_{i,j}$ (induced by the projections and coprojections) is a bijection. In particular filtered colimits of sets commute with finite products, fibre products and equalizers. The same holds for $M$ with values in abelian groups (and the map is then an isomorphism of abelian groups).
